title: SG-4.1 · Pin Phaser to 3.90.x in the frontend package.json and lockfile
summary: Pin Phaser to 3.90.x and keep the existing Phaser code working on it
description: Context: game/frontend/package.json declares phaser ^4.2.1 and package-lock.json resolves 4.2.1. The parent goal requires Phaser 3.90. Desired behavior: the manifest and lockfile resolve to a 3.90.x release, and the existing Phaser modules (createGame, config, BootScene, PhaserHost) compile and behave the same. Expected result: no Phaser 4 range or version remains. Why: the StoryForge redesign mandates Phaser 3.90.
acceptance_criteria: Given package.json, When read, Then the phaser dependency range only admits 3.90.x versions
Given package-lock.json, When read, Then the node_modules/phaser entry and the root dependencies entry both resolve to 3.90.x
Given the frontend modules that import phaser, When type-checked, Then they compile against 3.90 types
